title: CastChaos's better mace
body:
We all know that the default mace looks absolutely awful. So, I tried to redesign the mace to make it have a 3D model and also give it some copper theming. This is my first Blockbench project.
![This is how it looks on Blockbench](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32b2ef4fb6fe6c11d7596bfd27c45c3454482799.png)

In the near future **(hopefully**), I might add a wind charge animation to it if the mace has the windburst enchantment.

F**or any suggestions or issues that you have, you can DM me at discord (CastChaos69420#1648)**
